an3.18:1.1: sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
an3.18:1.2: devalokūpapattiyā āvuso samaṇo gotamo brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti
an3.18:1.3: nanu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ puṭṭhā aṭṭiyeyyātha harāyeyyātha jiguccheyyāthāti.
an3.18:1.5: iti kira tumhe bhikkhave dibbena āyunā aṭṭiyatha harāyatha jigucchatha dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbena adhipateyyena aṭṭiyatha harāyatha jigucchatha.
an3.18:1.6: pageva kho pana bhikkhave tumhehi kāyaduccaritena aṭṭiyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbaṃ vacīduccaritena … manoduccaritena aṭṭiyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbanti. 19
